name: The Principal Source
summary: Dendrite Starblaze sends Horde druids to Dreadmist Peak for a water sample. From Moonglade, she asks them to bring it to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, where it can help explain the poison harming wildlife.

sections.title: A Mountain Tainted
sections.body: Dreadmist Peak rises northwest of the Crossroads, with springs and pools high above the dry northern Barrens. Their waters shape local weather and moisture. The Burning Blade, a cult devoted to demons, has taken hold on the crags. Dendrite Starblaze fears their foul sorcery may taint the basin around this important mountain.

sections.title: A Plague on the Plains
sections.body: Sick gazelles stumble across the northern savanna, north of the main east-west trail through the Crossroads. Tonga Runetotem seeks help for the local tauren and turns to the Cenarion Circle to learn what is poisoning the herd. Druids who reach the peak and bring back a sample of its tainted water give Tonga what he needs to study the sickness and brew an antidote.

faq.q: Where do I get the water sample for this quest?
faq.answer: Draw water from the pool at the summit of Dreadmist Peak, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. The Burning Blade gathers there, and Dendrite Starblaze provides a sampler for the water.

faq.q: Why is the water on Dreadmist Peak so important to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Dreadmist Peak's high pools influence the local weather and mist. When the Burning Blade fouls them, poisoned vapor and runoff spread across the plains below and sicken wildlife in the northern Barrens.

Tonga Runetotem is a tauren druid at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Alarmed by the strange sickness afflicting local gazelles, he asked the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade to help diagnose and cleanse the land.

faq.q: Who is corrupting the water on the peak?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade has corrupted the waters. Its demon-worshiping warlocks and fel practitioners occupy the winding paths and summit of Dreadmist Peak.

faq.q: What ability does completing this chain teach?
faq.answer: The rite of Power over Poison teaches young Horde druids the spiritual and herbal knowledge needed to cure poisons in the field.

faq.q: Can Alliance druids do this quest?
aliases: can night elves do principal source
faq.answer: No. The Principal Source is the Horde trial, sending druids to the Barrens to help Tonga Runetotem. Alliance druids make a similar journey in Darkshore to learn to cleanse poisons.

angles.text: As a druid, you trace corruption to its source and isolate magical toxins before they can ruin an ecosystem.
As a tauren, you help protect the gazelle herds of the Barrens, ancestral lands of Kalimdor's tribes, from demonic taint.
As a member of the Horde, you help guard the Crossroads, a vital center of Horde life in Kalimdor, from demonic blight that threatens trade and survival.
